mapper.select: SELECT id, oper_no, dbuser, oper_name, valid_flag, create_time, update_time -- 主键,操作员工号,登录ID,姓名,有效标志,创建时间,更新时间 FROM tr_prehosp_oper ORDER BY id
SELECT oper_no FROM tr_prehosp_oper WHERE valid_flag = 1 ORDER BY oper_no -- 有效操作员工号
SELECT oper_no, oper_name FROM tr_prehosp_oper WHERE valid_flag = 1 ORDER BY oper_no -- 工号,姓名
SELECT oper_no FROM tr_prehosp_oper ORDER BY oper_no -- 操作员工号
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tr_prehosp_oper WHERE oper_no = #{operNo} -- 数量
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tr_prehosp_oper (id, oper_no, dbuser, oper_name, valid_flag, create_time, update_time) VALUES (seq_tr_reports.NEXTVAL, #{operNo}, #{dbuser}, #{operName}, 1, SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE tr_prehosp_oper SET valid_flag = #{validFlag}, update_time = SYSDATE WHERE id = #{id}
